propositions: Full-suite scheduler load causes git-fetch dribble tests to intermittently fail with false stall detection due to delayed wake-ups reducing actual throughput below the configured rate.
Tests incorrectly apply the same 2-second low-speed window to both zero-byte stall controls and above-floor dribble transfers, conflating deterministic stall behavior with scheduler-sensitive pacing.
Cumulative catch-up calculation for delayed wake-ups does not prevent stall detection after libcurl aborts during a single uninterrupted scheduling gap exceeding the window.

Stable fix requires separating zero-byte stall tests (2-second window), one production-window integration test with real Git/libcurl (10-second window), and deterministic unit tests for cumulative pacing math.
